subject: MAP: Security review & SOC 2 evidence delivery — HelioBank
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodai.com>
To: Samantha Ruiz <samantha@heliobank.com>, Michael O'Leary <michael.oleary@heliobank.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodai.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodai.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Mar 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: MAP: Security review & SOC 2 evidence delivery — HelioBank

Hi Samantha / Michael — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have a single source of truth for the MAP milestone around security / SOC 2 evidence delivery.

Key objectives from the call:
- HelioBank to complete security questionnaire and provide SOC 2 evidence artifacts needed for our internal onboarding and compliance assessment.
- Redwood to provide a packaged SOC 2 bundle and point contacts for evidence intake and technical Q&A.
- Target close: HelioBank security sign-off + PO by end of March (we discussed 03/31 as target, flagged below).

Draft MAP milestones (please review and flag changes):
1) Security questionnaire completion — owner: HelioBank (Samantha) — due: 2027-03-19 — dependency: answers to application architecture questions
2) Evidence bundle delivery (logs, access lists, config snapshots) — owner: HelioBank security — due: 2027-03-26 — dependency: legal review of subprocessors
3) Redwood SOC 2 package (attestation, control descriptions) — owner: Redwood (Ben / Vivek) — due: 2027-03-22 — dependency: internal export approvals
4) Final security review / sign-off — owner: HelioBank security + Redwood security — due: 2027-03-29
5) Procurement (PO + contract countersign) — owner: HelioBank procurement (Michael) — target: 2027-03-31

Immediate asks for HelioBank:
- Please return the attached security questionnaire (PDF) with as many fields filled as possible by 2027-03-19.
- If you have a preferred artifact delivery mechanism (secure SFTP, SharePoint, or Drive link) let us know so we can provision intake.

Attachments: HelioBank_Security_Questionnaire_v1.pdf (fillable).
Also uploaded: MAP-HelioBank-v0.2.docx to the draft MAP folder (link below).

If the dates above look tight, call that out and we can adjust — want to keep momentum. I'll follow up with a short calendar invite for a weekly 30m sync for evidence intake starting next week.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodai.com | +1 415-555-0162

From: Samantha Ruiz <samantha@heliobank.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodai.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodai.com>
Cc: Michael O'Leary <michael.oleary@heliobank.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Mar 2027 12:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: Security review & SOC 2 evidence delivery — HelioBank

Thanks Ben — appreciate the clear recap. We attached the questionnaire with initial answers and some notes where we need clarification (see attached PDF). A couple of clarifying points from our side:
- For evidence delivery, we prefer a secure SharePoint link. I'll coordinate with our infosec ops to provision a folder and will share the link by Monday.
- Our legal team is due to publish the subprocessor list by 03/18; that may create a short dependency on your side.
- Procurement needs an estimated monthly cost to start the PO process; can you confirm the committed monthly amount if we go with the dedicated plan you outlined?

Attachment: HelioBank_Security_Questionnaire_v1_filled.pdf (annotated)

Samantha Ruiz
InfoSec Manager | HelioBank
samantha@heliobank.com | +1 617-555-4098

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodai.com>
To: Samantha Ruiz <samantha@heliobank.com>, Michael O'Leary <michael.oleary@heliobank.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodai.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodai.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Mar 2027 16:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: Security review & SOC 2 evidence delivery — HelioBank

Thanks Samantha — got the annotated PDF and the notes are super helpful. A few updates based on your input and Vivek's availability for technical Q&A: 

Updated milestone plan (v0.2) — adjusted dates where we saw dependency risk:
- Questionnaire returned (HelioBank) — due 2027-03-19 — status: in progress (received annotated)
- Redwood SOC2 package published (Redwood) — due 2027-03-22 — deliverable: Redwood_SOC2-package.zip (control narratives, auditor contact, evidence index)
- Evidence intake window open (HelioBank -> Redwood) — 2027-03-22 through 2027-03-26 — intake method: HelioBank SharePoint (Samantha to share link by 2027-03-15)
- Final security review call — 2027-03-29 — attendees: HelioBank security, Redwood security (Vivek), and Laura (Customer Success for handoff)
- Procurement + PO — target 2027-03-31 (Michael)

Redwood asks / commitments:
- We'll deliver Redwood_SOC2-package.zip by 03/22 (attached).
- Vivek will run a 60m technical Q&A session the week of 03/22 — will propose 40/60 slots in calendar invite.
- Point of contact for evidence intake: laura.bennett@redwoodai.com (for access checks) and vivek.kulkarni@redwoodai.com (technical).

Michael — on committed monthly cost, I confirmed internally: For the Dedicated plan we discussed (4x A5000 equivalent, reserved), committed monthly rate will be $36,000/month (note: final price subject to contract). I can provide a short pricing summary for procurement if that helps move the PO.

Links: MAP draft (https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cMAPDraft) | HubSpot deal (https://app.hubspot.com/deals/12345/HLB-2027-037)

Ben

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodai.com>
To: Samantha Ruiz <samantha@heliobank.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodai.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodai.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: Security review & SOC 2 evidence delivery — HelioBank

Thanks — quick technical notes to make the evidence intake smoother: 
- Evidence we will need from HelioBank (examples / preferred formats):
  - Access control roster (CSV export) — show admin/user roles and last activity dates
  - Network diagrams (PDF) — including VPC/subnet layouts if you connect to our VPCs
  - Audit logs (last 90 days) — standard syslog exports or Splunk/Datadog extracts (prefer CSV/JSON compressed)
  - Configuration snapshots (screenshots + export where possible) — e.g., S3 bucket policies, IAM roles
  - Pen test report / remediation notes (PDF) — if available within the last 12 months

A few dependencies and blockers to call out: 
- Subprocessor list from legal (HelioBank) — if there are restricted processors we may need to add a dataflow diagram and an additional control mapping.
- If HelioBank requires on-prem evidence ingestion (air-gapped), we need to discuss secure courier or offline media and that will add ~3 business days to intake timeline.

Proposed change: shift evidence intake end date to 2027-03-28 to allow HelioBank's legal to publish subprocessors on 03/18. If that works for your procurement cadence we can still hit the 03/31 PO target.

I'll be available for the technical Q&A on 03/23 at 11:00 PT — sending calendar hold separately.

Vivek Kulkarni
Senior Security Engineer | Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwoodai.com

From: Michael O'Leary <michael.oleary@heliobank.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodai.com>, Samantha Ruiz <samantha@heliobank.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodai.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodai.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 14:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: Security review & SOC 2 evidence delivery — HelioBank

Ben / Team — thanks for the organized plan. Procurement confirmed they can target a PO by 2027-03-31 provided we have:
- Final pricing summary (Ben) — needed by 2027-03-17 to start internal approval workflow
- Completed questionnaire + key evidence items (access roster, diagrams) — by 2027-03-26

We will share the SharePoint intake link by end of day Tuesday (03/16). Our legal team expects to publish subprocessors on 03/18; if Redwood needs to review any additional control mappings please flag them after Vivek's Q&A.

One more ask: can Redwood provide a single-page evidence index (CSV preferred) listing each artifact name, owner, and a short description to speed our intake? If you can attach that to the SOC2 package deliverable that would help.

Michael O'Leary
Senior Procurement Manager | HelioBank
michael.oleary@heliobank.com | +1 212-555-8832
